name: Patrick Zammit

career.title: Management roles incl. European CFO and President, EMEA Electronic Marketing
President, Europe (expanded to Europe and APJ in 2021)

background_rationale: After starting as a consultant and serving as a European CFO, he spent most of his career running regional and global distribution businesses at Avnet and Tech Data before becoming COO and then CEO.

notable.summary: At TD SYNNEX's 2025 Investor Day, set medium-term targets including 10-12%+ annual non-GAAP EPS growth and returning 50-75% of free cash flow to shareholders.

Reporting fiscal 2025 revenue of $62.5 billion and $777.5 million returned to shareholders, Zammit said the company had substantially surpassed the initial medium-term targets set at its Investor Day.
Reporting fiscal third-quarter revenue of $21.6 billion, up 37.7% year over year, and a 9% dividend increase, Zammit said enterprise AI adoption was moving toward broader production deployments.

personal_story.hook: Patrick Zammit joined Avnet in 1993 after working as an Arthur Andersen consultant; 31 years later he became TD SYNNEX's CEO.
personal_story.summary: Zammit earned a French master's-level business degree from ESLSCA Business School and began his career as a senior consultant at Arthur Andersen. In 1993 he joined electronics distributor Avnet, where he served as European CFO and president of its EMEA Electronic Marketing division before becoming global president of its Technology Solutions division. When Tech Data bought that business in 2017 he became Tech Data's president for Europe, a role that expanded in 2021, the year Tech Data merged with SYNNEX, to include Asia-Pacific and Japan. He became chief operating officer in 2024 and succeeded Rich Hume as CEO that September.

facts.value: Moved with Avnet Technology Solutions to Tech Data when it acquired the business in 2017
